correctness.rationale: For m≥3 two vertices in one clique fiber have a third common neighbor. In neighboring fibers a mixed-label pair has a common Cartesian corner; a same-label pair does not. In fibers two steps apart the shared neighborhood is through an intervening fiber and requires matching labels. For n≥5 these cases exhaust common neighbors and give the exact cyclic-word characterization. No three successive fibers can be occupied, hence 3|S|≤2n. The directed two-symbol-state transfer uses exactly the allowed triples; its indexed closed walks correspond one-to-one to indexed packing words, with deficit 2n−3|S|. Splitting the color vector into constant and zero-sum parts, the off-diagonal color adjacency J−I acts by a and −1 respectively. The constant block has determinant (1−q²x)(1−a qx²−ax³)−m q³x³−m q²x⁴, which simplifies to the first factor of D_m; the zero-sum block gives 1+qx²+x³ with multiplicity a. The formal trace/logarithm identity then counts every size. Expanding through q² gives the three displayed coefficients at the least allowable deficits 0,1,2; each is positive for the stated k and a≥2, so the upper bound is sharp and the coefficients count precisely the maxima. An independently written subset- and series-check agreed in all sizes in three direct graph instances and with cyclic-word histograms for m=3, 5≤n≤12 and m=4, 5≤n≤10.
